_about: Early warning signals of the clickable points (content/featured-points.json) for the card "Early warning signals" of the Vegetation page. Written by analysis/satellite/export_points.py from the export of ews_monthly_new.ipynb; never edit by hand. Only points with a loss breakpoint and enough data before it (status "ok") have series; those run over "dates" (the months before lossStart). p = share of the nSurrogates AR(1) surrogates with a tau at least as high as the observed one.
